title: Hessdalen expedition in the early 1980s

tellings.quote:
First, uh, in the 1980s, early
1980s, we and you from Norway had this
huge expedition there and we could take
pictures of them. We can also see them
on radar once.

plain: In the early 1980s a large expedition went to Hessdalen, a valley in Norway known for things seen in its sky, and managed to photograph them and once even pick them up on radar. The researcher Clas Svahn tells this as someone who was part of that joint Swedish and Norwegian effort, and if true it would mean whatever appears there is solid enough to be caught by cameras and instruments.
